summary.zh: 在PTE Academic和IELTS学术写作中，避免口语化是提升语言分数、增强论证可信度和保持学术语域的重要能力。口语化表达通常包括缩写形式、日常词汇、情绪化判断、模糊指代、俚语、习语、过度使用第一或第二人称，以及不够精确的动词和名词。学术写作要求考生使用正式、客观、准确、逻辑清晰的表达方式，例如用“children”替代“kids”，用“significant”替代“big”，用“individuals”或“people”替代“guys”，用“therefore”替代“so”。对于中国学生而言，常见问题包括直接翻译中文口语、使用过于简单的万能词、把议论文写成聊天式表达，以及为了显得高级而使用不自然的复杂词。本课重点帮助学习者识别非正式语言，并将其改写为适合PTE和IELTS的学术表达。

structure.formula: Informal expression → Formal academic expression → Objective and precise sentence
structure.explanation: 避免口语化的核心不是把每个词都换成复杂词，而是根据学术语境选择更准确、更客观、更正式的表达。正式学术句子通常具备三个特点：第一，词汇具体而准确，例如用“increase”或“rise”替代笼统的“go up”；第二，语气客观，避免“I think”“you can see”“of course”等主观或对话式表达；第三，句法完整，避免缩写、碎片句和过于随意的连接词。在PTE Write Essay和IELTS Writing Task 2中，考生应使用正式连接词、名词化结构、被动语态、抽象名词和学术搭配来提高语域。例如，“A lot of people think technology is good”可以改为“Many individuals argue that technology has brought substantial benefits to society.” 这种改写不仅更正式，也更符合评分标准中对lexical resource、grammatical range和coherence的要求。

examples.en: Informal: A lot of students think online classes are great.
examples.zh: 非正式：很多学生觉得网课很棒。

examples.en: Formal: Many students consider online learning to be an effective educational approach.
examples.zh: 正式：许多学生认为在线学习是一种有效的教育方式。

examples.en: Informal: The government should do something about pollution.
examples.zh: 非正式：政府应该对污染做点什么。

examples.en: Formal: The government should implement effective measures to address environmental pollution.
examples.zh: 正式：政府应采取有效措施来应对环境污染。

usage_scenarios.title: 议论文中表达观点
usage_scenarios.description: 在PTE Write Essay和IELTS Writing Task 2中，表达个人立场时应避免聊天式表达，如“I think”“I feel”“you know”。更合适的方式是使用客观句式，如“It can be argued that”“This essay will discuss”“There is strong evidence that”。

examples.en: Informal: I think working from home is pretty good for workers.
examples.zh: 非正式：我觉得居家办公对员工挺好的。

examples.en: Formal: It can be argued that remote working provides employees with greater flexibility and improved work-life balance.
examples.zh: 正式：可以认为，远程办公为员工提供了更大的灵活性，并改善了工作与生活的平衡。

usage_scenarios.title: 描述原因和结果
usage_scenarios.description: 学术写作中应避免使用过于口语化的因果连接词，如“so”“because of this”“that is why”。更正式的表达包括“therefore”“as a result”“consequently”“This may lead to”。这些连接词在PTE Summarize Written Text和Write Essay中尤其重要。

examples.en: Informal: Many people use cars, so the air gets worse.
examples.zh: 非正式：很多人使用汽车，所以空气变差了。

examples.en: Formal: The widespread use of private vehicles contributes to a decline in air quality.
examples.zh: 正式：私家车的广泛使用导致空气质量下降。

usage_scenarios.title: 描述数据、趋势和变化
usage_scenarios.description: 在IELTS Writing Task 1或PTE中涉及图表、摘要和概括时，应避免使用“go up”“go down”“a lot”“big change”等日常表达。应改用“increase”“decrease”“substantially”“a significant change”等更精确的学术表达。

examples.en: Informal: The number of tourists went up a lot in 2020.
examples.zh: 非正式：游客数量在2020年上升了很多。

examples.en: Formal: The number of tourists increased substantially in 2020.
examples.zh: 正式：游客数量在2020年显著增加。

usage_scenarios.title: 提出解决方案
usage_scenarios.description: 提出建议时，应避免使用“fix the problem”“do something”“make things better”等模糊表达。学术写作要求解决方案具体、动词准确，例如“address the issue”“implement policies”“enhance public awareness”。

examples.en: Informal: Schools should do something to help students with stress.
examples.zh: 非正式：学校应该做点事情来帮助学生应对压力。

examples.en: Formal: Schools should introduce mental health programs to support students experiencing academic pressure.
examples.zh: 正式：学校应引入心理健康项目，以支持承受学业压力的学生。

usage_scenarios.title: 概括他人观点或研究结论
usage_scenarios.description: 在学术语境中概括观点时，应避免“people say”“some guys believe”“everyone knows”等不严谨表达。可使用“research suggests”“some commentators argue”“it is widely acknowledged that”等更正式的表达。

examples.en: Informal: People say social media is bad for teenagers.
examples.zh: 非正式：人们说社交媒体对青少年不好。

examples.en: Formal: Some researchers suggest that excessive social media use may have negative effects on adolescents.
examples.zh: 正式：一些研究者认为，过度使用社交媒体可能会对青少年产生负面影响。

common_mistakes.wrong: A lot of people think that university is too expensive.
common_mistakes.correct: Many people argue that university education is excessively expensive.
common_mistakes.explanation: “A lot of”在学术写作中偏口语化，可根据语境改为“many”“a large number of”或“a significant proportion of”。“think”也较普通，议论文中可替换为“argue”“believe”“maintain”或“contend”。

common_mistakes.wrong: Kids should not spend too much time on phones.
common_mistakes.correct: Children should not spend excessive time using mobile phones.
common_mistakes.explanation: “Kids”是日常口语词，正式写作中应使用“children”。“too much time”可以根据语境改为“excessive time”，表达更正式、更准确。

common_mistakes.wrong: The government needs to fix this problem.
common_mistakes.correct: The government needs to address this issue through effective policy measures.
common_mistakes.explanation: “fix this problem”过于口语化且不具体。学术写作中常用“address this issue”“tackle this problem”“implement measures”等表达，并说明解决方式。

common_mistakes.wrong: This is a big problem for society.
common_mistakes.correct: This constitutes a significant social problem.
common_mistakes.explanation: “big”是高频基础词，在正式写作中常显得不够精确。根据语义可改为“significant”“serious”“major”“substantial”。“constitutes”可增强学术语气。

common_mistakes.wrong: You can see that technology changes our life.
common_mistakes.correct: It is evident that technology has transformed modern life.
common_mistakes.explanation: 学术写作应避免直接称呼读者的“you”。“You can see that”属于对话式表达，可改为“It is evident that”“It is clear that”。同时，“changes our life”应改为更准确的“has transformed modern life”。

common_mistakes.wrong: I think the advantages are more than the disadvantages.
common_mistakes.correct: The advantages appear to outweigh the disadvantages.
common_mistakes.explanation: “I think”在考试议论文中过于主观，除非题目明确要求个人观点，也应尽量使用更客观的表达。“more than”可改为固定学术表达“outweigh”。

common_mistakes.wrong: The internet brings us lots of good things.
common_mistakes.correct: The internet provides numerous benefits for individuals and society.
common_mistakes.explanation: “lots of good things”非常口语化且含义模糊。正式表达应使用“numerous benefits”“considerable advantages”“positive outcomes”等具体名词。

common_mistakes.wrong: Students can get a lot of knowledge from online courses.
common_mistakes.correct: Students can acquire substantial knowledge through online courses.
common_mistakes.explanation: “get”是口语中常见万能动词，学术写作中应根据含义替换为“acquire”“obtain”“gain”“receive”等。“a lot of knowledge”可改为“substantial knowledge”。

common_mistakes.wrong: This policy is really bad and unfair.
common_mistakes.correct: This policy may be ineffective and inequitable.
common_mistakes.explanation: “really bad”情绪化且不精确。“bad”应根据具体含义改为“ineffective”“harmful”“problematic”等。“unfair”在学术语境中可使用“inequitable”。

common_mistakes.wrong: Nowadays, people are crazy about social media.
common_mistakes.correct: In recent years, social media has become increasingly popular among the general public.
common_mistakes.explanation: “crazy about”是口语化表达，不适合正式写作。可用“has become increasingly popular”表达趋势。“Nowadays”并非绝对错误，但在学术写作中常被滥用，建议根据时间范围使用“In recent years”。

pte_usage.description: 避免口语化在PTE Academic中非常重要，尤其影响Written Discourse、Grammar、Vocabulary和Form等评分维度。在Write Essay中，正式语域能够使文章更符合学术议论文要求；在Summarize Written Text中，考生需要把原文信息压缩成一个语法完整、表达正式的长句，不能使用聊天式或随意表达；在Summarize Spoken Text中，笔记内容转化为答案时也应避免“the speaker says it is super good”这类口语表达。PTE评分系统倾向于识别清晰、正式、准确的语言，因此考生应使用学术动词、抽象名词、正式连接词和客观句式，而不是依赖日常词汇和模糊判断。
sections: Reading & Writing: Fill in the Blanks

academic_patterns.pattern: It can be argued that + clause
There is considerable evidence that + clause
This issue should be addressed through + noun phrase
academic_patterns.translation: 这一问题应通过……来解决。

academic_patterns.pattern: X has a significant impact on Y
X is associated with + noun phrase
The advantages of X outweigh its disadvantages
It is essential to distinguish between X and Y
This may lead to + noun phrase
A more effective approach would be to + verb
The extent to which + clause + remains debatable

ai_tips: 写作完成后，检查是否出现缩写形式，如“don't”“can't”“it's”。在正式学术写作中通常应写成“do not”“cannot”“it is”。
把高频口语词替换为更精确的学术词：用“increase”替代“go up”，用“children”替代“kids”，用“substantial”替代“big”，用“address”替代“deal with”。
避免使用直接对话式表达，如“you can see”“as we all know”“let me tell you”。这些表达会降低PTE和IELTS写作的正式度。
不要为了显得高级而使用不自然的生僻词。正式语言的重点是准确、自然和符合语境，而不是堆砌复杂词汇。
在PTE Summarize Written Text中，答案应像一条正式新闻摘要或学术概括，避免使用主观评价和日常评论式语言。

practice_questions.question: 将句子改写为正式学术表达：A lot of people think the internet is good for education.
practice_questions.answer: Many people argue that the internet provides significant benefits for education.

practice_questions.question: 将句子改写为正式学术表达：The government should do something about traffic.
practice_questions.answer: The government should implement effective measures to address traffic congestion.

practice_questions.question: 将句子改写为正式学术表达：Kids spend too much time watching TV.
practice_questions.answer: Children spend excessive time watching television.

practice_questions.question: 将句子改写为正式学术表达：I think online learning is better than traditional learning.
practice_questions.answer: Online learning may be more effective than traditional classroom-based learning in certain contexts.

practice_questions.question: 将句子改写为正式学术表达：The number of cars went up a lot last year.
practice_questions.answer: The number of cars increased substantially last year.

practice_questions.question: 将句子改写为正式学术表达：This problem is really bad for young people.
practice_questions.answer: This issue may have serious negative effects on young people.

practice_questions.question: 将句子改写为正式学术表达：People get a lot of information from social media.
practice_questions.answer: People obtain a substantial amount of information from social media.

practice_questions.question: 将句子改写为正式学术表达：The company wants to make things better for workers.
practice_questions.answer: The company aims to improve working conditions for employees.

practice_questions.question: 判断下列句子是否适合PTE Write Essay，并给出修改：You can see that pollution is a big problem.
practice_questions.answer: 不适合。正式改写：It is evident that pollution constitutes a significant environmental problem.

practice_questions.question: 判断下列句子是否正式，并给出修改：Social media is kind of harmful to teenagers.
practice_questions.answer: 不正式。正式改写：Social media may be harmful to adolescents when used excessively.
